title: Device Check
subtitle: Please enable camera and microphone to join the interview. Access permissions are only used during this session.

cameraStatus.blockedOrDark: Camera is blocked or room is too dark. Remove the lens cover or turn on more lights.
cameraStatus.blocked: Camera is blocked or too dark
cameraStatus.blockedExplanation: For transparency during the interview, you need to have your face clearly visible to the camera. Remove the lens cover or turn on more lights — the join button will unlock as soon as the camera detects a clear image.

microphoneStatus.speakNow: Try speaking — the bar will move according to your voice.

noDeviceWarning: Without an active camera/microphone, you cannot join the interview.

errorHelp.denied: Open the permission icon in your browser address bar → allow Camera & Microphone → press Retry.
errorHelp.notfound: Connect a camera/microphone and make sure no other application is using them, then Retry.
errorHelp.lost: Camera/microphone permissions were just disabled or the device was disconnected. Enable permissions again and press Retry to join the interview.
errorHelp.other: Please check your device and try again.
